title: Passengers with multiple bookings
statementMd:
List passengers (by name) who made more than one booking. Show name and count, by count then name.

Expected columns: `passenger`, `bookings`.

Tables: `airlines`, `airports`, `flights`, `bookings`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT passenger, COUNT(*) AS bookings FROM bookings GROUP BY passenger HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY bookings DESC, passenger;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
